strategy_note: Trigger (compiled solc_version) is trivially extractable, same as the S-level compiler-bug requirements -- but the comparison target ('the latest available stable Solidity compiler version') is a MOVING, externally-defined reference point, not derivable from the code or even from the frozen EthTrust spec text itself. REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE in a narrow sense: needs an external, time-anchored reference (e.g. the Solidity release list as of the evaluation date) to be meaningful -- a genuinely different kind of gap than the S/M-level compiler-bug requirements, which compare against FIXED version thresholds.

implementation_status.note: Resolves the moving-target gap by making the comparison reference a REQUIRED caller-supplied parameter rather than a value hardcoded in this module (which would silently go stale the moment a new Solidity release ships). The external-evidence dependency stays visible and auditable per-run (the caller's supplied value is itself inspectable evidence) instead of hidden inside a predicate that looks self-contained but isn't.
